subject: maths
question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 18 minutes and 30 minutes, respectively. Pipe C, attached to the tank can drain off 125 litres of water per minute. If all the pipes are opened together, than tank is filled 45 minutes. The capacity of the tank, in litres is:
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by Pipe A to fill a tank = 18 min

Time taken by Pipe B to fill a tank = 30 min

Pipe C drain off 125 litres of water per minute

all the three pipes opened together = 45 min

**Calculation:**

LCM of 18, 30 and 45 is 90

Efficiency of Pipe A = (90/18) = 5 l/min
